title: One-winner recovery generation fence from live collision evidence

target.output: one-winner recovery generation fence + collision-loss receipt
target.scope: stale recovery claim/run allocation for one opportunity generation

problem: The recovery critic already identified F3_RECOVERY_GENERATION_NO_FENCE. At 2026-09-17 09:51 -03 the live Page Thread Bridge gate reproduced it: at least two distinct append-only recovery claims and two R2 run records appeared for the same stale predecessor generation. The current recovery protocol preserves history but does not provide atomic one-winner execution ownership across distinct recovery attempt IDs.
mission: Repair stale-recovery allocation so one stale generation has exactly one mutable execution owner without erasing append-only evidence. Reuse the existing lease/retry owner rather than creating a competing implementation. Losing contenders must persist an auditable collision/loss receipt and re-enter allocation. Keep late original/recovery returns reconcilable by the steward; do not introduce newest-wins.
acceptance: derive a deterministic stale_generation_id from opportunity + last accepted durable signal/predecessor lineage
atomically fence mutable recovery execution so concurrent contenders for one stale_generation_id produce exactly one winner
persist loser collision receipts instead of silently disappearing or starting overlapping runs
represent overlap evidence as proven-none / proven-active / unknown and fail closed for mutable takeover when unknown
replay the 2026-09-17 Page Thread Bridge collision as a regression fixture and prove only one contender receives mutable execution authority
preserve all original/recovery claims, runs and late returns as immutable evidence and require explicit steward reconciliation
dependencies: O-SWARM-LEASE-RETRY-BUILD-V1 existing implementation and follow-up ownership
candidate_write_scope: follow-up candidate paths owned by O-SWARM-LEASE-RETRY-BUILD-V1 or a steward-generated successor opportunity

value_signals.unblock_value: High: Page Thread Bridge is a shared dependency of all four S2 local integration lanes, and duplicate recoveries add write-collision risk exactly at a gate unlocker.
value_signals.compounding_value: High: one-winner recovery fencing applies to every future stale opportunity and reduces duplicate work, unsafe overlap and human arbitration.
value_signals.regression_prevention: High: converts an already-predicted critic failure into a concrete reproducible regression case from live canary evidence.

failure_modes: two recovery contenders mutate the same candidate scope
two terminal returns race and force avoidable reconciliation
a later contender mistakes missing overlap proof for proven absence
append-only attempt IDs are confused with exclusive execution ownership

fail_if: two concurrent contenders for the same stale_generation_id can both enter mutable execution
the design deletes or overwrites prior recovery evidence
unknown overlap is treated as no overlap
a loser can seed a normal STARTED mutable run after losing the fence
late original/recovery returns are auto-discarded by recency
falsification.pass_if: A concurrent replay of the captured Page Thread Bridge recovery race yields exactly one mutable execution winner, durable loser collision receipts, preserved historical evidence and deterministic steward reconciliation inputs.
